subject: Merge pull request #5 from zackcam/unstable
reason: The change is entirely build/CI/test infrastructure: it adds a GitHub Actions workflow, reworks build.sh and the README to use SERVER_VERSION (dropping 7.2.x for 8.0.0), and refactors the Python integration-test harness to pass a server path instead of a version enum (plus a typo fix). No module source code (src/*.rs) is touched, so the module's runtime behaviour — commands, replies, data, persistence — is unchanged between parent and change, and there is nothing a server-side scenario could reach or compare.
